text: I kept the old coat for years, long after it had grown too small, as if holding on to it might preserve the person I had been. In its pocket, I found a faded cinema ticket. I could not remember the film, but I remembered the friend beside me, our laughter and the walk home. I placed the ticket in a drawer, a small home for the memory, then donated the coat. Some things can leave us without taking the past with them.
